description: Ambrissh’s supermarket theory of building a profitable service agency: reach the right customers, deliver useful work and earn repeat business through trust.
deck: Demand gets a business started. Trust gives people a reason to come back.
excerpt: Why I’m building around accessible service, sensible margins and customers who come back.

description: Ambrissh compares AI-native SEO and GEO with vibe coding: understand the workflow, use AI on specific gaps and verify the result before calling it progress.
deck: A polished output can hide an unfinished workflow. I see the same risk in AI-built software and AI-generated search work.
excerpt: What building with AI taught me about search: own the brief, inspect the gaps and test what comes back.
